verdict.rationale: DPMA runs online services (DPMAregister, DEPATISnet, DPMAdirekt e-filing), so programmatic event subscriptions such as register-status changes are a fair axis. However, the evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event-subscription mechanism. The only evidence covers search databases, filing routes and a robots.txt probe, none of which is about webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
